authority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only cross-enemy-partial-facet-extra-chip for one separately preregistered trace-only null and focused-mediator identity preflight. facetOwnershipPartition.definition: At card-play start, the current chip target itself has 0 < chips < facet_max.
facetOwnershipPartition.reason: The target-local partial-Facet payoff, generic Shatter flow and same-enemy reseam direction are immutable bounded negatives. Changing the payoff or threshold would reopen those families.

facetOwnershipPartition.definition: At card-play start, another living enemy distinct from the current chip target has 0 < chips < facet_max.
facetOwnershipPartition.reason: Exact state stores a Facet vector but no tested mechanism reads partial Facet ownership across enemy identities. This is a new topology relation, not a target-local threshold, card subset, status predicate, global Attack buff or unconditional chip scalar.

frontierScope.claimBoundary: This audit can identify one source-defined state representation for trace-only identity preflight. It cannot establish natural policy capacity, causal effect, candidate feasibility, carrier, acquisition, package acceptance or product authority.
excluded: payoff level other than exactly one extra Facet chip
frontierScope.included: A one-extra-Facet deterministic predicate evaluated from the pre-card partial-Facet ownership relation among current living enemies. It may read only existing enemy hp, chips, facet_max and identity plus the existing Dusk aspect and positive implicit Attack-chip boundary.

selectedPrimitive.exactEffect: For Duskblade only, when an Attack draws unblocked blood and would apply positive implicit Facet chips to target e, add exactly one chip if the pre-card snapshot contains a different living enemy with 0 < chips < facet_max.
selectedPrimitive.orderSafety: The snapshot is frozen before card effects. Same-card target iteration cannot create its own eligibility.
requiredTrace: pre-card living enemy hp, chips and facet_max
selectedPrimitive.stateRepresentation: A card-scoped snapshot of living enemy identities whose Facet state is partial before the card resolves.
